description: Round-6 trace-deficit probe redone under canonical tr_M from the derivation-chain registry (PR #473). Hypothesis B = E_0 · |Z·tr_M(p) + N·tr_M(n) − tr_M(atom)| applied to D with E_0 calibrated on proton.

data.verdict: trace-deficit hypothesis FALSIFIED at canonical convention (+70134.7% off on D)

comparison.note: Non-canonical convention (atomic-tr-m-mpfr-50dps) and canonical convention (D-tr-M-q0.derivation.json) give DIFFERENT round-6 predictions because the two Wenzl-Schur normalizations differ per-atom non-uniformly (factor 1.99 on p, 1.72 on n, 0.46 on D).
